title: Stir-Fried Aubergine with Jamaican Jerk Chicken
description: A flavorful and spicy Chinese-inspired dish featuring juicy chicken and tender aubergine.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken to the skillet and cook until browned, about 5-6 minutes.
Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside.
Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil to the skillet and add the aubergine.
Cook the aubergine until tender, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the roasted peanuts, soy sauce, honey, garlic, and ginger to the skillet.
Stir to combine and cook for 1 minute.
Return the chicken to the skillet and stir to combine.
Cook for an additional 2-3 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve the chicken and aubergine over jasmine rice.
Sprinkle with red pepper flakes, if desired.
